purpose: Map backend science events into human conversation language. One mapping, enforced in code (TOSCANINI_UI/webapp/lib/productEvents.ts), pinned by executable tests (tests/adversarial_product_events.test.mjs, 12/12). The frontend never renders the backend's machine summary as conversation (BS-009); the summary is preserved as technical detail (brief 15) via the title attribute and the journal surface.

kinds: stage.{STAGE} (STAGE in: RETRIEVE, FREEZE, PREMISE_GATE, SYNTHESIZE, VERIFY, MULTI_SOURCE_DISCOVERY, COLLISION, PHYSICS, ATTACK, CONTRADICTION, KILLER_EXPERIMENT, ADJUDICATION, CLASSIFY, NEXT_BEST_ACTION, RANK)
backend_event_vocabulary.transport: /api/run/{id}/stream (SSE 'science' frames) + /api/run/{id}/events (merged journal + investigation projection, deduplicated by event_id)

frontend_consumers: components/Conversation.tsx (live line + last-4 event feed; backend summary rides title)
components/ScienceEvents.tsx (journal surface keeps the raw summary under Technical details - brief 15)

problem.extract|ACTIVE.conversation: I'm reading your problem — extracting what it claims, what it assumes, and what would count as success.

problem.extract|COMPLETED.conversation: The problem is framed — the investigation works from your own words.

evidence.retrieval_started|ACTIVE.conversation: Investigating evidence — I'm searching the indexed sources now.

evidence.retrieved|COMPLETED.conversation: Evidence came in from {source} — {count} records. (structured source/count fields used when the event carries them; otherwise a generic honest sentence)
evidence.retrieved|COMPLETED.guard: never implies relevance beyond what the record established (Art. XXI: search count is not evidence; per-record relevance lives in the evidence surface)

evidence.retrieval_failed|FAILED_INFRAST.conversation: One of the evidence sources could not be reached. That is an infrastructure state — absence is never concluded from a failed source, and the investigation continues.
evidence.retrieval_failed|FAILED_INFRAST.forbidden: No evidence exists. / Nothing was found.

evidence.bound|COMPLETED.conversation: The evidence base is bound to the problem — every record is custody-tracked.

stage.RETRIEVE|ACTIVE.conversation: Investigating evidence — I'm searching the indexed sources now.

stage.FREEZE|ACTIVE.conversation: Freezing the evidence base so every claim traces to a hashed record.

stage.PREMISE_GATE|ACTIVE.conversation: Checking that the problem itself holds up before building on it.

stage.SYNTHESIZE|ACTIVE.conversation: Comparing mechanisms — I'm working out what could actually cause this effect.

stage.SYNTHESIZE|COMPLETED.conversation: Candidate mechanisms are formed. They are hypotheses to be tested, not conclusions.
stage.SYNTHESIZE|COMPLETED.forbidden: I found the answer. / The mechanism is proven.
stage.SYNTHESIZE|COMPLETED.constitutional_basis: Art. XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion); brief 17

stage.VERIFY|ACTIVE.conversation: Verifying that the evidence actually says what it is claimed to say.

stage.MULTI_SOURCE_DISCOVERY|ACTIVE.conversation: Searching beyond the obvious sources for supporting and contradicting work.

stage.COLLISION|ACTIVE.conversation: Checking the emerging ideas against prior art.

stage.PHYSICS|ACTIVE.conversation: Checking the physics of the emerging candidates.

stage.ATTACK|ACTIVE.conversation: Challenging the leading candidate — I'm trying to disprove it.
stage.ATTACK|ACTIVE.brief_22_example: ATTACKING_CANDIDATE -> I'm trying to disprove the strongest candidate.

stage.ATTACK|COMPLETED.conversation: The adversarial challenge has run. Its outcome is in the record, stated exactly as recorded.
stage.ATTACK|COMPLETED.forbidden: Survived. (a completed attack stage is not a survival verdict - the candidate surface derives the verdict from the challenge record, Test F)

stage.KILLER_EXPERIMENT|ACTIVE.conversation: Designing the decisive experiment — the one that could kill the candidate.

stage.CLASSIFY|ACTIVE.conversation: Classifying what the investigation actually established.

stage.RANK|ACTIVE.conversation: Ranking the remaining candidates by evidence and risk.

stage.*|FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE|BLOCKED.conversation: A technical step could not complete — that is infrastructure, not a verdict about the idea.

stage.*|FAILED_SCIENTIFIC.conversation: A step of the investigation recorded a scientific failure — kept as a finding, stated in the record.

stage.*|QUEUED.render: nothing — never a fake action line

geometry.created|COMPLETED.conversation: The technology model is ready to inspect.
geometry.created|COMPLETED.forbidden: The invention is validated. (a render never validates physics - BS-025, Art. XXVIII)

package.completed|COMPLETED.conversation: The technology package is assembled and ready.

investigation.terminal|COMPLETED.conversation: The investigation reached its outcome — stated below exactly as recorded.

investigation.terminal|FAILED_INFRASTRUC.conversation: The technical work hit an infrastructure wall. The test could not be completed — nothing has been rejected because of it, and the run can resume where it stopped.
investigation.terminal|FAILED_INFRASTRUC.brief_22_example: BLOCKED_PROVIDER -> The technical test is temporarily unavailable. The candidate has not been rejected.
investigation.terminal|FAILED_INFRASTRUC.forbidden: The candidate failed. / No invention survived.

investigation.terminal|FAILED_SCIENTIFIC.conversation: The investigation ended without a supported candidate. That is a recorded scientific outcome, not an infrastructure failure.

unknown_kind|ACTIVE.conversation: Still working — the investigation is progressing.

unknown_kind|COMPLETED.conversation: A step of the investigation is recorded.

unknown_kind|infrastructure.conversation: A technical step paused — infrastructure, not a verdict.

closed_vocabulary_rules: Every event kind the journal can emit maps to a sentence; unknown kinds/statuses fall through to honest generic sentences, never to silence (ACTIVE) and never to machinery.
QUEUED renders nothing (never a fake action line).
The map is a pure function of (kind, status, structured event fields) — it never parses the backend summary string and never invents counts.
Infrastructure statuses: FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE, BLOCKED (+TRANSPORT_ERROR defensively). infrastructure:true sentences must never name a scientific verdict.
No sentence contains machine vocabulary (pinned by the G1 test regex: engine stage / persisted its envelope / envelope_* / recorded at / raw kind tokens / event ids).

briefing_idealized_events_without_a_back.note: The 28-chapter briefing's examples (MECHANISM_FOUND, ATTACKING_CANDIDATE, BLOCKED_PROVIDER) are covered by real backend events (stage.SYNTHESIZE, stage.ATTACK, investigation.terminal/evidence.retrieval_failed). The following idealized event names from the product-event direction have NO distinct backend kind today; the UI does not fabricate them. Smallest Coder-1 contracts defined per brief 27.

coder1_contracts.current_behavior: the candidate arc is derived from the canonical challenge records (deriveCandidates + deriveAttackState), and the ATTACK stage events render through the map; no per-candidate event exists in the journal
coder1_contracts.smallest_contract: one journal kind 'candidate.challenge' with {gen, verdict: REJECTED|SURVIVED|CONTESTED, reason} emitted when the challenge record lands; the UI maps verdicts to the existing candidate-surface language (no new epistemology)

coder1_contracts.idealized_event: MECHANISMS_IDENTIFIED with a count ('I found three plausible mechanisms')
coder1_contracts.current_behavior: stage.SYNTHESIZE COMPLETED renders the honest hypothesis sentence; a mechanism count is only shown from the canonical generations projection on the candidates message (the count the record actually carries)
coder1_contracts.smallest_contract: the SYNTHESIZE envelope persistence already carries the candidate list; if a count-bearing conversation sentence is wanted, add {count} to the stage event payload — the map renders it only when the record carries it (never invented)

coder1_contracts.current_behavior: reality-loop state is surfaced on the invention view (RealityLoopPanel); fresh-run conversations have no such events yet
coder1_contracts.smallest_contract: journal kinds 'reality.observed' and 'candidate.mutated' emitted by the reality loop closure path; the UI maps them to outcome-difference language ('The new observation changed the design: {delta}')
